question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To pass the hat round
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To ask for contributions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"To pass the hat round"** means to ask people to contribute money for a particular purpose. (पैसे मांगना)

 
 
• **Example: **We had to pass the hat round to collect enough money for the charity event.
 
 
 
• **"To ask for contributions"** involves requesting monetary or other forms of donations from people. (योगदान मांगना)
 
 
• **Example: **The organization asked for contributions to support their new project.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that **"To pass the hat round"** means **"To ask for contributions"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. To ask for contributions**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To oppose someone** (किसी का विरोध करना): To actively resist or refuse to comply with someone.

 
 
• **Example:** He decided to oppose someone in the committee's decision.
 
 
 
• **To delay a plan** (योजना को स्थगित करना): To postpone or put off a plan to a later time.
 
 
• **Example: **They had to delay the plan due to unforeseen circumstances.
 
 
 
• **To share the responsibilities** (जिम्मेदारियों को साझा करना): To divide and distribute the duties among a group of people.
 
 
• **Example:** It is important to share the responsibilities to ensure the project runs smoothly.
